candidate.name: MultiDC Shoham

prior_physical_source.scope: Prior frozen source retains dated chiller-installation evidence. This locator-only investigation does not replace it or advance its date.

findings: Kardan's 2025 annual report section 7.13.1(a), physical page 24 / printed page Aleph-21, identifies a 27.4-dunam Shoham Industrial Zone property planned for three server facilities. Two facilities under the current build occupy approximately 60 percent of the land; a third is contingent on market conditions. Treat this as one campus, not three new sites.

The relevant annual-report section describes piles in November 2024 and construction work from January 2025. These historical dates are not a new May-August 2026 physical observation. The report provides no selected street number, parcel identifier or numeric campus location.

An official Israeli Ministry of Environmental Protection air-emission permit, number 2213, names Amazon Data Services Israel Ltd's Shoham site and assigns it Rakefet 4 in Hevel Modiin Industrial Park. That address therefore cannot establish MultiDC's location merely because a business-directory lead associates the same address with the venture.

The Amazon permit is an exclusion of an unsupported locator bridge, not evidence that the two developments share a campus, and not proof of their surveyed separation. No Amazon geometry, construction status, capacity or certification is imported.

Current Geva and Minrav project pages identify the Shoham Industrial Zone and the joint-venture construction scope but did not close an exact campus locator. Undated under-execution wording does not refresh lifecycle evidence.

Historical same-owner land-transfer and MultiLog project search leads were not promoted to parcel evidence: the discovered 30,271-square-metre tract differs from the 27,400-square-metre campus and lacks an adjudicated identity bridge. No geometry is borrowed from a neighboring Amazon site or a similarly named owner.
candidate.next_evidence_needed: A direct named-project link to a municipal parcel or a first-party numeric campus locator, with source CRS, rights, precision and full-cohort geometry deduplication. Do not repeat the empty Nominatim query or the previously denied Magna report route without a genuine evidence change.
candidate.deduplication_limit: No candidate geometry was selected, so there is no new spatial distinctness or point-in-polygon result. The 173-site baseline is unchanged.
